# `kurtosis`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the kurtosis value calculated from values of a group.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
kurtosis(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.6.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- kurtosis, example 1
> SELECT kurtosis(col) FROM VALUES (-10), (-20), (100), (1000) AS tab(col);
-0.7014368047529609
```

```sql
-- kurtosis, example 2
> SELECT kurtosis(col) FROM VALUES (1), (10), (100), (10), (1) as tab(col);
0.19432323191698986
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.6.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
